name: Vol-of-vol shock fade — daily implied overshoot (1d)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the vol-of-vol shock fade on the DAILY bar — slower, one decision per day, so it tests whether the implied-overshoot reversion persists over days rather than hours, and whether the daily 30d-implied vs realized comparison is cleaner on its natural horizon): a sharp up-repricing of dvol is the options market pricing convexity faster than spot warrants; VOV spikes are the most transient part of the surface (Du 2025, JFM) and revert because the repricing overshoots the real information. We proxy the shock by dvol above a fitted level WHILE realized has not yet expanded (vol_realized below a fitted ceiling -> implied racing ahead) AND a recent multi-day dip (ret_Nd negative -> the panic dumped price). We fade with a spot long into the reversion. The counterparty is gamma-scalping desks mechanically bidding vol-of-vol during the shock — forced buyers at the wrong price. Distinct from dvol-spike-capitulation (LEVEL extreme): a mid-level dvol fires if implied outruns a calm realized. Exit: vol_realized crosses up (realized caught up, overshoot resolved) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: replace the implied-ahead-of-realized trigger with a dvol LEVEL threshold only — if the static level matches, the VOV thesis is unsupported and this is a dvol-spike re-skin. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the plain multi-day dip-buy (drop both vol legs) matches, this is generic oversold, not a vol-family edge. HARD CAVEAT: ~148 DVOL points on the daily grid is thin -> paper-only.
catalyst: a daily implied-vol overshoot ahead of still-calm realized — a vol-of-vol panic to fade
